title: Webbed Cloister
shortDescription: An old walk has been lent to silk and patience.
longDescription:
The cloister once belonged to the abbey that stood before the Collegium. Silk has taken the arches without tearing the stone. A lantern hangs in a web, still lit, as if someone meant to come back for it.
South, the silk thickens. Something small moves there when you stop pretending not to listen.

fixtures.name: Caught Lantern
fixtures.examineDescription: The lantern still burns a blue Collegium flame. Silk holds it as a nurse holds a cup. No one has been trapped. The web is a shelf. Whoever hung the light expected a longer night than this.
